store.0: Michael is interested in knowing if your coffee machines come with warranties or quality guarantees. He has had negative experiences with short warranty periods and poor customer service in the past, and he is hoping for a more accommodating policy with your brand, especially for higher-end models.

Michael is concerned about the delayed delivery of his espresso machine, which was supposed to be delivered within 11 business days. He has not received any updates or the package, and the tracking information seems to be stuck. He is hosting a gathering and wants to showcase the machine, but now needs to consider alternative options like using a drip coffee maker or visiting a local coffee house.
